question: What changed after the decision to freeze an interface, and how much churn followed?
sql:
WITH freeze AS (
    SELECT MIN(authored_date) AS freeze_date
    FROM v_commit
    WHERE subject ILIKE '%freeze%' AND subject ILIKE '%interface%'
)
SELECT
    c.authored_date,
    c.repo_slug,
    c.contributor,
    c.subject,
    c.insertions,
    c.deletions,
    (c.insertions + c.deletions) AS commit_churn,
    SUM(c.insertions + c.deletions) OVER (ORDER BY c.authored_date) AS cumulative_churn_after_freeze
FROM v_commit c, freeze f
WHERE c.authored_date > f.freeze_date
ORDER BY c.authored_date
